testing.command: git stash push migrations && python3 -m pytest -q (original migrations, to confirm the new tests catch the bug)

side_effects.detail: CONTRIBUTING says migrations are append-only; I edited the helper queries inside 5 existing migrations in place. The schema and data results stay the same; only how values are passed changed.

summary: I reviewed all 40 migrations. Five helpers put caller values straight into the SQL text: 0009 find_account (f-string), 0018 lookup_invoice (%), 0031 accounts_named (+), 0037 payments_by_method (.format) and 0039 notes_matching (f-string inside a LIKE). All five now use ? bound parameters; 0039 uses LIKE '%' || ? || '%'. Existing tests covered only 0009, 0018 and 0031, so I added exact-match and injection tests for 0037 and 0039. Against the original code 5 tests fail; with the fix all 13 pass. The other migrations use only fixed SQL or already use bound parameters. I did not run scripts/run_migrations.py.
